{{Virgo}}

Virgo is the 10th month of the [[Gaian calendar]]. It contains 28 days (4 weeks) and corresponds to ISO weeks 37–40.

== Overview ==
===Etymology===
English ''Virgo'' "maiden" (Latin). Japanese: {{ill|乙女座|ja|Otome-za}} “maiden-constellation.”  
===Gaiad themes===
Weeks 37–40 (Days [[Virgo 1]]–[[Virgo 28]]):   

Repentence for the genocide of Native Americans  

Early modern period from a Eurasian perspective  

From [[Virgo 12]] or Rosh Hashanah to [[Virgo 20]] (Yom Kippur) to [[Virgo 26]] (Sukkot) it is the contemplative high holy days, in reference to Judaism  
===EVENTS===
* [[Virgo 12]] — Mid-Autumn Festival  
* [[Virgo 14]] — [[:Category:Days_that_Shindensai_(神殿祭)_falls_on|Shindensai]]
